bandReport.notes: Both seams are clean. p08 (band b3) ends with Q59 complete — its option (d) is the last line of that page's right column — and p09 opens on Q60, so nothing straddles the leading seam. p11 ends with Q77 complete (all four options on p11) and p12 opens on Q78, so nothing straddles the trailing seam. NO Directions / 'Consider the following for the next N items' block appears anywhere on p08-p12, so this band owns no set and strands none: every question here is standalone. Two questions break across COLUMNS within a page (not a band seam): Q69's stem is at the foot of p10's left column with its options at the top of p10's right column, and Q75's stem is at the foot of p11's left column with its options at the top of p11's right column — both fully transcribed. NO question in this band references a printed figure: 'given figure'/'figure given below' occurs nowhere on p09-p11, and the geometry items (Q68 parallelogram, Q70 chords, Q73 circles in a right-angled corner, Q76 rectangle diagonals) each state their configuration entirely in words, so no hasFigure/figureNote is set. DECIMAL SEPARATOR — cross-band inconsistency for the merge pass to settle, flagged not resolved: the booklet prints decimals with a raised middle dot (Q70 shows '9·2 cm', '9·6 cm', '9·8 cm'). This band writes them as ASCII '9.2', matching bands b1 and b2, which use ASCII throughout; band b5 preserves U+00B7 and band b6 uses both forms. I did not edit another band's file. Every stem, option and numeral in this band was re-read from the source PDF at 7-9x zoom; no misprint and nothing illegible.

questions.stem: What is \((\tan x + \tan y)(1 - \cot x \cot y) + (\cot x + \cot y)(1 - \tan x \tan y)\) equal to ?
What is \(\sqrt{\frac{\sec x - \tan x}{\sec x + \tan x}}\) equal to ?
If \(\theta\) lies in the first quadrant and \(\cot\theta = \frac{63}{16}\), then what is the value of \((\sin\theta + \cos\theta)\) ?
What is the value of \(\frac{1 - 2\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta}{\sin^4\theta + \cos^4\theta} + 4\) equal to ?
A rectangle is 48 cm long and 14 cm wide. If the diagonal makes an angle \(\theta\) with the longer side, then what is \((\sec\theta + \operatorname{cosec}\theta)\) equal to ?
questions.subtopic: Trigonometric Ratios in a Right Triangle
flags: Subtopic invented: the catalog has no entry for plain right-triangle ratio computation (its trig subtopics are identities, specific values, compound angles, max/min).

questions.stem: What is the area of the triangle having side lengths \(\frac{y}{z} + \frac{z}{x}\), \(\frac{z}{x} + \frac{x}{y}\), \(\frac{x}{y} + \frac{y}{z}\) ?
If the angles of a triangle are \(30^\circ\) and \(45^\circ\) and the included side is \((\sqrt{3} + 1)\) cm, then what is the area of the triangle ?

\(ABCD\) is a plate in the shape of a parallelogram. \(EF\) is the line parallel to \(DA\) and passing through the point of intersection \(O\) of the diagonals \(AC\) and \(BD\). Further, \(E\) lies on \(DC\) and \(F\) lies on \(AB\). The triangular portion \(DOE\) is cut out from the plate \(ABCD\). What is the ratio of area of remaining portion of the plate to the whole ?
Two circles of radii 20 cm and 16 cm intersect and the length of common chord is 24 cm. If \(d\) is the distance between their centres, then which one of the following is correct ?
In a circle of radius 5 cm, \(AB\) and \(AC\) are two chords such that \(AB = AC = 8\) cm. What is the length of chord \(BC\) ?
Two circles touch internally. The sum of their areas is \(136\pi\) cm\(^2\) and distance between their centres is 4 cm. What are the radii of the circles ?
If area of a circle and a square are same, then what is the ratio of their perimeters ?

A circle of diameter 8 cm is placed in such a manner that it touches two perpendicular lines. Then another smaller circle is placed in the gap such that it touches the lines and the circle. What is the diameter of the smaller circle ?

The thickness of a cylinder is 1 foot, the inner radius of the cylinder is 3 feet and height is 7 feet. To paint the inner surface it requires one litre of a particular colour. How much quantity of the same colour is required to paint all the surfaces of the cylinder ?
A square and a rectangle have equal areas. If one side of the rectangle is of length numerically equal to the square of the length of the side of the square then the other side of the rectangle is

options.label: A
options.text: square root of the side of the square

options.label: B
options.text: half the side of the square

options.label: D
options.text: double the side of the square

questions.stem: The length and breadth of a rectangle are in the ratio \(4 : 3\). Then what is the ratio of the area of the triangle formed by the parts of the diagonals with a long side to the area of the triangle formed by the parts of diagonals with a short side ?
Suppose a region is formed by removing a sector of \(20^\circ\) from a circular region of radius 30 feet. What is the area of this new region ?
